subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw provide a shared pre-dispatch text-acknowledgement lifecycle, and if so should it be a portable `messages` configuration contract or an explicit non-terminal plugin/channel hook?
rationale: Both routes add compatibility-sensitive public surface and determine where channel-specific placeholder, typing, and cleanup behavior belongs; current code does not make that ownership decision automatically.

options.title: Define a portable lifecycle
options.body: Specify one shared acknowledgement lifecycle and a minimal portable configuration contract, with channels mapping it only where their transport supports it.

options.title: Add a non-terminal extension seam
options.body: Expose a documented send-and-continue hook so channel plugins or external plugins own visible interim text without a global messages option.

options.title: Keep channel-specific UX only
options.body: Leave visible progress to channel-owned presence, typing, and placeholder features instead of promising cross-channel text parity.

recommendation.title: Define a portable lifecycle
recommendation.body: Specify one shared acknowledgement lifecycle and a minimal portable configuration contract, with channels mapping it only where their transport supports it.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent reply-dispatch and acknowledgement lifecycle history provides the strongest routing signal for choosing the shared boundary.
